definitions.explanation: The central and most important part of something. Used in biology for the cell nucleus, in physics for the atomic nucleus, and figuratively for the core member or central element of a group or organization.
Used as a prefix in compound words related to nuclear energy, nuclear weapons, or nuclear science.

examples.japanese: ⟦{細胞|さいぼう}→細胞：05030_saibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{核|かく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}する→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{核|かく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a core player on the team.

examples.english: It is the young researchers who form the core of this research group.

{核|かく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{脅威|きょうい}→脅威：13932_kyoui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷戦|れいせん}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS (sense 2, nuclear):
- ⟦{核兵器|かくへいき}→核兵器：13126_kakuheiki⟧: nuclear weapons
- {核実験|かくじっけん}: nuclear test
- {核融合|かくゆうごう}: nuclear fusion
- {核分裂|かくぶんれつ}: nuclear fission
- ⟦{核家族|かくかぞく}→核家族：16326_kakukazoku⟧: nuclear family

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (sense 1, core):
- {核|かく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as the core
- {核|かく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{成|な}す: to form the nucleus of
- ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{核|かく}: the core of an organization

USAGE:
⟦{核家族|かくかぞく}→核家族：16326_kakukazoku⟧ (nuclear family) uses {核|かく} in the sense of "core/nucleus" rather than "nuclear weapons," though the English term "nuclear family" has the same etymological origin.
